normal_speed_evidence.method: Original MP4s played in local browser at 1x and 0.5x; root received discrete screenshots, not an uninterrupted video stream. Player showed unequal playback positions; not a synchronized/certified full pair review.
normal_speed_evidence.half_speed_samples: Start for both, later slow endpoint and dash around 3.945s. Not complete half-speed coverage.

decision_reason: Owner approves motion direction, commissions compact gameplay timing; confirmed source fin cropping also needs correction. Preserve acting and fix source margins.
right_facing_review_evidence: Compact eager action is distinct in sampled frames, but [204,241) turns towards near-frontal upright finish. Preserve three-quarter right-facing readability while braking, not old-rest-pose equality.

issues.observation: The lower fin reaches/crosses the bottom image edge during launch; clearly truncated in f47-48.
issues.expected: Complete crown, fingers and both fin lobes remain visible with breathing room throughout the performed arc.
issues.reconstruction: Compose the next native generation with enough lower margin for the full launch excursion; do not crop, pad, shrink/reposition parts or paint missing fin pixels locally.

issues.observation: The fin touches/crosses the bottom border again during the ending; final lower lobe is cut off.
issues.reconstruction: Keep braking motion in a bounded on-screen envelope with both fin tips fully visible; fixed camera and stable scale.

issues.observation: Ending becomes near-frontal and vertical, rather than a clearly right-facing brake.
issues.expected: Right-facing source family for deterministic left mirror; end pose can be natural without matching the old resting sprite.
issues.reconstruction: Keep head/chest/pelvis oriented right-three-quarter through deceleration; ease tail stroke and open soft braking palms without turning to face the viewer.

issues.observation: First proposed loop jumps from horizontal propulsion to upright arms-down pose. Second differs in arm/fin configuration and is not proven.
issues.expected: Recurring actual cruise cycles with compatible pose and incoming/outgoing velocity at an observed cut.
issues.reconstruction: Perform repeatable compact swim pulses; select true boundaries after viewing, not by 48-frame arithmetic. No duplicated cycles, retime, optical flow or crossfade.

issues.observation: Owner finds ten-second performance pacing unsuitable for frequent 1-2s click-to-move actions.
issues.expected: Rapid commitment, native compact cruise cycles and short phase-compatible brake; preserve approved movement.
issues.reconstruction: Use EXCHANGE_07 timing targets in the next native take; no long look/gather, no mandatory whole-film playback. Prove actual source ranges and short action timing.
issues.evidence_basis: explicit owner feedback and gameplay-duration requirement, not an automated artistic score

owner_feedback.statement: The animations and motions themselves are great; speed and pacing do not fit click-to-move actions often lasting 1-2 seconds.
owner_feedback.scope: Preserve approved acting/style. Revise timing to compact entry, recurring core cycle and short stop. Not a new identity/acting redesign.
